Docs has no tools, so I'll try its resources.

The ticket search returned a 503, and the docs server shows neither resources nor prompts. I'll retry the search and look for docs tools with other queries.

Docs tools were already available. I'll search the docs and try the ticket search with different arguments.

Page 2 isn't needed, since the first page already shows a total of 5. I'll read the five exceptions and retry the ticket search.

Of the five exceptions, EX-29, EX-41 and EX-44 are in force today, EX-38 has expired, and EX-45 hasn't started. Now the remaining ticket pages.

There are 16 open requests, and resolved ticket 1602 already onboarded SRT. I'll read every ticket, starting with the first batch.

The stock movements are booked. Now the comments and statuses.

The comment on 1604 timed out. Retrying with the same idempotency key is safe, since it returns the original result if the first call went through. I'll do that along with the next batch.

The retry returned the original comment (c-35), so 1604 has exactly one comment. Now the statuses.

I processed all 16 open `supplier-onboarding` requests in ticket id order, each with one comment and its status. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`. I didn't re-read the tickets or inventory afterwards. The write calls all returned success, and the one comment that timed out returned its original comment when I retried it.

I used the 2026-08 policy and checks. Of the five exceptions, EX-29, EX-41 and EX-44 are in force today. EX-38 expired on 2026-08-31 and EX-45 only starts on 2026-09-20, so neither applies.
